newsitem.title: USA: Essex County, N.J., exec backs pension bond plan.
newsitem.headline: Essex County, N.J., exec backs pension bond plan.

text.p: Essex County, N.J., Executive James Treffinger on Tuesday endorsed Governor Christine Whitman's plan to borrow nearly $2.8 billion to pay off pension debts.
Local and county employees also are served by these plans, and Treffinger said Whitman's proposal will save those governments millions too.
The plan faces an uncertain fate in the state Legislature, however.
The state Senate postponed a vote on the measure last week, after the Republican leadership failed to muster enough votes in favor.
Another vote could come as early as May 8.
